name: ElectricVehicle
label: Whole vehicle
blurb: The car as a whole. Top-level promises to the customer live here.

name: PowertrainSystem
label: Powertrain
blurb: Electric motors, reduction gears and half-shafts that turn electricity into motion.

name: TractionInverter
label: Traction inverter
blurb: Converts battery DC into the AC the motor needs, and sets how hard the motor pushes.

name: EnergyStorageSystem
label: Battery pack
blurb: The skateboard battery under the floor. Stores the energy for range and acceleration.

name: BatteryManagementSystem
label: Battery management
blurb: Watches every cell: charge level, temperature, and protection limits.

name: VehicleControlSystem
label: Vehicle controller
blurb: The central brain. Reads the driver and sensors, then commands torque and braking.

name: BrakeSystem
label: Brakes
blurb: Discs and calipers at each wheel, blended with motor regeneration.

name: ThermalManagementSystem
label: Cooling system
blurb: Radiator, fan and coolant loop that keep the battery and electronics at a safe temperature.

name: ThermalController
label: Thermal controller
blurb: Runs the coolant pump and fan based on temperatures.

name: VehicleSensorSystem
label: Sensors
blurb: Wheel-speed sensors, front radar and camera that tell the controller what is happening.

name: DriverInterfaceSystem
label: Driver interface
blurb: Dashboard, steering wheel, pedals and screen. How the driver commands and observes the car.

name: ChargingSystem
label: Charging port
blurb: Charge door and socket. Manages the handshake with a charging station.

name: ServiceDiagnosticsSystem
label: Diagnostics port
blurb: The service connector a technician plugs into to read faults and telemetry.

name: TractionMotor
label: Traction motor
blurb: The electric motor itself: turns inverter power into torque at the axle.

name: BatteryModule
label: Battery modules
blurb: The cell modules inside the pack that actually store the energy.

name: ChargePort
label: Charge socket
blurb: The socket and door where the charging cable plugs in.

name: OnboardCharger
label: Onboard charger
blurb: Converts AC from a wall charger into DC for the battery.

name: BrakeController
label: Brake controller
blurb: The electronic module that decides how much friction and regeneration to blend.

name: BrakeActuator
label: Brake calipers
blurb: The calipers that clamp the discs when friction braking is needed.

name: CoolantPump
label: Coolant pump
blurb: Circulates coolant between the radiator, battery and electronics.

name: SensorFusionController
label: Sensor fusion controller
blurb: Combines radar, camera and wheel data into one picture for the controller.

name: WheelSpeedSensor
label: Wheel-speed sensors
blurb: One sensor per wheel reporting how fast it turns.

name: DiagnosticGateway
label: Diagnostic gateway
blurb: The secure gateway that decides what a service tool may read or change.
